title: AI-Generated Music Banned from Australian Charts
subtitle: Decision Follows DJ's Revelation of AI Use in Madonna Remix
excerpt: Australia has banned AI-created music from its charts after a DJ admitted to remixing Madonna with artificial intelligence.
author: Daniele Morais
contentHtml:
Australia has decided to ban AI-generated music from its official charts. The measure was announced as a direct response to a recent case involving a DJ.

The DJ admitted to using AI to produce a remix of a Madonna song, and that version reached the top of the Australian charts. The revelation prompted chart authorities to prohibit the inclusion of AI-generated works.

Under the new rule, only tracks not produced with the aid of artificial intelligence will be eligible to compete for positions on Australia's music charts.

With information from BBC News.
